verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents a built-in Automations scheduler that persists jobs, wakes the agent, and delivers output to a chat channel or webhook. It also documents event triggers: Gateway HTTP hooks that let external services wake an agent, Gmail PubSub triggers, and an IMAP email trigger. Standing orders grant agents permanent operating authority for defined programs, and a community user confirms scheduling tasks across agents. missing for 10: documented rule syntax with conditions/filters on events, coverage of in-channel or internal events as triggers, and independent hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automations beyond scheduling.
